topline.text: The story of the day: a Guardian analysis of police FOI data (33 of England and Wales' 43 forces) finds at least 8,500 recorded sexual offences against under-13s on or near school premises between 2021-25 - nearly five a day, including close to 2,000 rapes or attempted rapes.
topline.action: Worth revisiting how confidently pupils know how - and to whom - to report concerns, and whether records distinguish peer-on-peer incidents clearly enough to spot patterns.

topline.text: A quieter day otherwise for national DfE announcements - today's main fixture is the National Alternative Provision Conference on SEND reform and inclusion-first accountability (see diary).

diary.text: National Alternative Provision Conference examines SEND reform and inclusion-first accountability.
DfE pupil premium quarter 2 payments for 2026/27 made to academies.
Midday deadline for Sheffield secondary school applications for September 2027 entry (national deadline 31 Oct).

sections.heading: National: near-daily sexual offences recorded in or near schools, Guardian analysis finds

items.lede: FOI data from two-thirds of forces shows thousands of recorded offences against under-13s.
items.body: At least 8,500 sexual offences against under-13s were recorded on or near school premises in England and Wales between 2021 and 2025 - nearly five a day - including close to 2,000 rapes or attempted rapes; about two-thirds of under-13 victims were girls, and most identified alleged offenders were themselves children. Only 33 of 43 forces supplied data, so the true total is almost certainly higher.
items.action: Worth checking harmful sexual behaviour training and reporting routes are current, especially for younger pupils and SEND pupils who may be less able to flag concerns.

sections.heading: Sheffield: GCSE table lands ahead of Y7 admissions deadline

items.lede: A round-up of Sheffield secondaries' GCSE grades arrives as the local application deadline nears.
items.body: The Star's look at Sheffield secondary schools' GCSE performance lands with the city's non-selective deadline to apply for September 2027 Year 7 places approaching on 16 October (national deadline 31 October) - useful context for parents weighing options this half term.
items.action: Pastoral and admissions leads may want it on hand for parent queries before half term.
